liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Oxen** (1 review): Explain Oxen is a retitled How Could I Know to avoid similarity [8]
- Identifies the first M. Ward collaboration as Outta My Head with Jim [6]
- Identifies the second M. Ward collaboration as Flaming Heart with MMJ [6]
- Identifies the third M. Ward collaboration as Helicopter with MMJ [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **How Do You Know**: rare: 10 archived performances [14]
- **Death Is The Easy Way**: rare: 14 archived performances [14]
- **chat**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [14]
- **Oxen**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [14]
- **End Cobra**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **? M Ward/Jim**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **? M Ward/MMJ**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **? M Ward/MMJ**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]

## The recordings

- **mmj2004-05-28.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 121 min; rated 4.75/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener rates this as the best sounding MMJ show in the archive; Listener notes high frequencies are prominent but overall quality is very good; Bass is low and guitars have excess treble, requiring output tweaks [1][2][3][10]

## Around the show

- M. Ward and Jim James performed the closing tracks of the concert [5]
- Intermittent power cable caused mic loss during the M. Ward opener [1]
- Listener finds the show less energetic than other archive recordings [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2004-05-28.flac16**: taped by David Klein; source: KM184 (fob) > V3 and soundboard > Duo [1]. Also: David Klein recorded and mastered the audio for this specific release [1]
